description: This file defines the EntityListBuilder class in Drupal, responsible for building and rendering entity listings with operations like view, edit, and delete.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Entity\EntityListBuilder
classes.description: A class that builds a listing of entities with operations like view, edit, delete, and rendering capabilities.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of EntityListBuilder using dependency injection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the entity type ID, storage, and entity type.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads entities based on entity IDs.

methods.name: getEntityIds
methods.description: Retrieves entity IDs using a query.

methods.name: getEntityListQuery
methods.description: Builds a query object for loading entity IDs with sorting and paging.

methods.name: getOperations
methods.description: Returns available operations (view, edit, delete) for an entity.

methods.name: getDefaultOperations
methods.description: Provides default operations for an entity, considering access permissions.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the header row for the entity list table.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds a table row for a specific entity.

methods.name: buildOperations
methods.description: Builds a list of operation links for an entity, suitable for rendering.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Builds the render array for the entity list table, including pagination.
